strongest_angle: Examine how Eritrean troops crossed the northern border into Ethiopia's Tigray region, prompting Ethiopia to lodge an official complaint with the UN Security Council.

key_facts.fact: Ethiopia accused Eritrea of an all-out invasion of its northern Tigray region in a letter sent to the United Nations Security Council.
Residents in the Tigrayan town of Adigrat told the BBC that Eritrean soldiers crossed into northern Ethiopia as fighting escalated.
Ethiopia told the United Nations Security Council that it is taking measures in self-defense against Eritrea after troops crossed the border.
